reasons.plausibility: Oxide dispersion strengthening by Y2O3 is well known in other alloys, and extending it to Ti- and Ni-primary high-entropy systems is scientifically reasonable, although the exact stability and effects in this new composition are not fully proven.
reasons.testability: Comparing identical alloys with and without Y under controlled conditions is straightforward and would provide a clear result regarding both mechanical property improvements and oxide formation.
reasons.usefulness: Proposing Y-based oxide dispersion to enhance high-temperature performance in a novel high-entropy alloy system is highly relevant and potentially valuable for future research.
